subject: Pilot pause — provisioning request & sandbox safety net
messages:
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@lytics.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 2 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot paused — integration blockers; request for sandbox top-up + extension

Hi Marissa,

Quick note from our engineering team — we hit two blockers during the ingest onboarding this morning and we've had to pause the pilot.

1) Incoming webhook schema mismatch: our middleware rejects Redwood payloads at the enrichment step.
2) SSO assertion fails intermittently for a subset of test users (looks like a cert rotation edge case).

Both are blocking our core demo flows; engineering estimates ~5 business days to get a proper fix in place. Given this, can Redwood: 
- extend the pilot window by 14 calendar days, and
- provision a one-time sandbox credit (we estimate ~100k tokens) so we can continue smoke-testing the new mapping once patched?

I've attached the raw logs and a short capture from the webhook consumer.

We want to avoid restarting the procurement cadence if this drags — the account team and I are hopeful for a quick accommodation so the POC stays on track.

Thanks,
Sanjay Rao
Head of Product
Lytix Analytics

Attachments: integration-log-20260802.txt
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@lytics.ai>
Cc: David Kim <david@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 2 Aug 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot paused — integration blockers; request for sandbox top-up + extension

Hi Sanjay — thanks for the heads up and for the log dump. Sorry to hear the team is blocked.

I'm looping in David and Karthik from our engineering/solutions team to confirm root cause and an ETA. I'll also escalate the credit/extension ask to our ops leads right after we have a short technical summary.

Quick questions for planning: can you confirm the rough token consumption expected for the smoke runs after the fix (50k vs 100k)? Also, is there a narrower subset of test traffic we can use to validate before the full run?

I expect to have an internal update in the afternoon PST and will share next steps.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0148
From: David Kim <david@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Sanjay Rao <sanjay@lytics.ai>
Date: Sun, 2 Aug 2026 14:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot paused — integration blockers; request for sandbox top-up + extension

Marissa — I dug into the logs. Short version: the webhook payload uses a custom nested array for 'events' that trips our schema validator on our enrichment side; the SSO failures look like expired cert references from the IdP metadata cache.

Work plan:
- Quick mitigation: add a permissive schema mapping for the nested array (1 engineer, ~6 hours) to keep ingest going for smoke tests.
- Permanent fix: patch the validator and add a schema regression test (2 dev days).
- SSO: force-refresh the IdP metadata in the test environment and push a short-lived hotfix (4–6 hours).

ETA for safe smoke runs is end-of-day Thu, Aug 6 (assuming we start Monday). That aligns with ~3 dev days total if we parallelize.

If Sales wants a contingency, I'd recommend a 14-day extension and a 75k token sandbox bump — that gives the customer room to validate without reopening procurement.

I'm attaching a short diagnostic extract I saved.

—David
David Kim
Senior Engineer, Integrations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: engineer-diagnostics.txt
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@lytics.ai>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 09:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot paused — integration blockers; request for sandbox top-up + extension

Quick add from my side — there is a lightweight workaround we can push to Lytix's staging today: map the nested events array into a flattened envelope before the validator runs. That will let them run end-to-end flows at reduced payload fidelity.

Risks: it won't exercise the full enrichment path but is enough for smoke validation. If they accept, David and I can support the staging deploy and a short verification window.

Estimate: 0.5 engineer-days to ship workaround + coordination. Full validator fix still as David outlined (~2 dev days).

Karthik
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 15:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot paused — integration blockers; request for sandbox top-up + extension

Thanks team — approving a one-time concession to keep the pilot healthy.

Approval (conditions below):
- Grant Lytix Analytics a 14-calendar-day extension to their pilot window starting on the current pilot end date.
- Apply a one-time sandbox credit equivalent to 75,000 tokens to the Lytix account (Deal RDW-2026-3492).
- Condition: engineering deploys either the workaround to staging within 24 hours or provides a firm Aug 6 ETA for the full fix. If neither happens, we'll re-evaluate the concession.

Marissa — please confirm in writing to the customer with the conditions and update the HubSpot record.

Jonas Weber
VP, North America Sales Operations
jonas@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Pilot paused — integration blockers; request for sandbox top-up + extension

Hi Sanjay / Helen — thanks for the patience. Short update and confirmation of next steps.

1) Extension & credit: Jonas has approved a one-time 14-day extension to your pilot and a 75k token sandbox credit tied to RDW-2026-3492. The credit will be visible in your sandbox account by COB tomorrow.

2) Technical path: Karthik and David will push the staging workaround today (flatten 'events' per the attached verification checklist) so you can resume smoke validation. Permanent validator fixes are scheduled and targeted for Aug 6.

3) Next steps I propose:
- Today: staging workaround deploy + 2-hour verification window (Redwood on-call will join).
- Tue/Wed: smoke tests by Lytix engineering; Redwood follows up on any regressions.
- Aug 6: permanent fix rollout; validation complete.

I've attached a short mutual action plan that reflects the timeline and owners. If that looks good, we'll update HubSpot and formally record the extension.

Please reply with a one-line ack so I can close this loop on our side.

Best,
